snippet.title: FATAL FURY: CotW × STREET FIGHTER｜Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Street Fighter’s Ken and Chun-Li rev into overdrive in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves!
Ken and Chun-Li from renowned fighting game franchise Street Fighter (Capcom) are joining FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves! Their inclusion amounts to a legendary crossover like no other, as Fatal Fury’s Terry Bogard and Mai Shiranui have themselves already been announced for Street Fighter 6.
Ken and Chun-Li will serve as DLC characters in Season Pass 1 of FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves. Ken is slated to arrive in Summer 2025, with Chun-Li following in Winter 2025. More details will be revealed in due course.
